# Requirements: Custom Title Bar

## Overview
Replace the native window title bar with a custom application-specific toolbar that integrates window controls (close button) and application actions (add, grid, settings) while maintaining essential window management functionality (dragging, closing).

## User Stories

### US-1: Custom Title Bar Display
**As a** user  
**I want** to see a custom title bar instead of the native macOS window controls  
**So that** the application has a modern, integrated appearance with more vertical space

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- The native window decorations (traffic light buttons) are hidden
- A custom toolbar appears at the top of the window
- The toolbar contains a red close button on the left
- The toolbar contains action buttons (Plus, Grid, Settings) next to the close button
- The toolbar contains a chevron button on the right for sidebar toggle
- The toolbar has a consistent height and styling matching the design mockup

**EARS Notation:**
- **WHEN** the application window is displayed
- **THE** custom title bar **SHALL** be visible at the top
- **AND** native window decorations **SHALL** be hidden

### US-2: Close Window Functionality
**As a** user  
**I want** to click the red button to close the application window  
**So that** I can exit the application using the custom controls

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Clicking the red close button closes the application window
- The close button has a hover state for visual feedback
- The close button is positioned on the left side of the toolbar
- The button is circular and red in color

**EARS Notation:**
- **WHEN** the user clicks the red close button
- **THE** application window **SHALL** close
- **WHERE** the close button is in the custom title bar

### US-3: Window Dragging
**As a** user  
**I want** to drag the window by clicking and dragging anywhere on the custom title bar  
**So that** I can reposition the window on my screen

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- The entire custom title bar region acts as a drag handle
- Dragging works on any empty space in the title bar
- Interactive elements (buttons) do not trigger dragging when clicked
- The drag behavior matches native window dragging behavior

**EARS Notation:**
- **WHEN** the user clicks and drags on the custom title bar
- **THE** window **SHALL** move to follow the cursor
- **EXCEPT** when clicking on interactive buttons

### US-4: Toolbar Button Functionality
**As a** user  
**I want** the toolbar buttons (Plus, Grid, Settings, Chevron) to remain functional  
**So that** I can access application features from the custom title bar

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- The Plus button adds a new todo item
- The Grid button maintains its current functionality
- The Settings button toggles language (current behavior)
- The Chevron button toggles the sidebar visibility
- All buttons have hover states
- Buttons do not trigger window dragging when clicked

**EARS Notation:**
- **WHEN** the user clicks a toolbar button
- **THE** corresponding action **SHALL** execute
- **AND** window dragging **SHALL NOT** be triggered

## Functional Requirements

### FR-1: Window Configuration
- The application **SHALL** disable native window decorations
- The window **SHALL** maintain its current size constraints (min: 400x500, default: 600x700)
- The window **SHALL** remain resizable

### FR-2: Custom Title Bar Component
- The custom title bar **SHALL** be positioned at the top of the window
- The title bar **SHALL** have a fixed height
- The title bar **SHALL** contain a close button, action buttons, and a sidebar toggle
- The title bar **SHALL** use the existing design system (Tailwind CSS, Radix UI)

### FR-3: Window Controls
- The close button **SHALL** invoke the Tauri window close API
- The title bar **SHALL** support window dragging via the Tauri drag API
- Interactive elements **SHALL** prevent drag behavior when clicked

### FR-4: Visual Design
- The close button **SHALL** be circular, red, and 12px (3 units) in diameter
- The close button **SHALL** have a hover state with reduced opacity
- The title bar **SHALL** have a bottom border matching the current design
- The title bar **SHALL** maintain consistent spacing with existing UI

## Non-Functional Requirements

### NFR-1: Performance
- Window dragging **SHALL** be smooth and responsive
- Button interactions **SHALL** have no perceptible delay

### NFR-2: Cross-Platform Compatibility
- The implementation **SHALL** work on macOS (primary target based on screenshot)
- The implementation **SHOULD** work on Windows and Linux
- Platform-specific styling differences **SHALL** be handled gracefully

### NFR-3: Maintainability
- The custom title bar **SHALL** be implemented as a reusable component
- The implementation **SHALL** follow existing code patterns and conventions
- The code **SHALL** use TypeScript for type safety

### NFR-4: Accessibility
- The close button **SHALL** have an appropriate aria-label
- All interactive elements **SHALL** be keyboard accessible
- Focus states **SHALL** be visible

## Technical Constraints

### TC-1: Technology Stack
- **MUST** use Tauri v2.8.5 APIs
- **MUST** use React 19.1.0 with TypeScript
- **MUST** use existing UI component library (Radix UI + Tailwind CSS)
- **MUST** use Lucide React for icons

### TC-2: Tauri APIs
- **MUST** use `getCurrentWindow().close()` for closing the window
- **MUST** use `getCurrentWindow().startDragging()` for window dragging
- **MUST** use `data-tauri-drag-region` attribute for drag regions
- **MUST** add required permissions to capabilities configuration

### TC-3: Existing Code
- **MUST** modify `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` to disable decorations
- **MUST** update `src-tauri/capabilities/default.json` with window permissions
- **MUST** modify `src/components/todo-window.tsx` to implement custom title bar
- **SHOULD** extract title bar into a separate component if complexity warrants

## Dependencies

### External Dependencies
- `@tauri-apps/api` (already installed) - for window management APIs

### Internal Dependencies
- `src/components/ui/button.tsx` - for toolbar buttons
- `src/index.css` - for styling
- Existing icon imports from `lucide-react`

## Out of Scope

The following are explicitly **NOT** included in this specification:

- Minimize and maximize window controls (only close button required)
- Custom window resize handles
- Window transparency or blur effects
- Animated window transitions
- Multi-window support
- Custom context menus for the title bar
- Backwards compatibility with Tauri v1

## Success Metrics

- The custom title bar is visually identical to the provided mockup
- All window management functions (close, drag) work correctly
- No regression in existing functionality (todo management, sidebar, etc.)
- Code passes TypeScript compilation without errors
- Application builds and runs successfully on macOS

## Assumptions

- The user is running macOS (based on the screenshot showing macOS-style window)
- The existing window configuration is acceptable except for decorations
- The red close button is the only window control needed (no minimize/maximize)
- The current toolbar button functionality should be preserved
- The application is intended for desktop use only (not mobile)
